exposure: Women with SLE and previous IUGR
Women with SLE and secondary APS

Women with SLE and previous IUD or stillbirth

cohort: This study included 197 women with SLE who had at least one previous adverse obstetric outcome.
finding: The study found that a predefined multidisciplinary care pathway-based management improved pregnancy outcomes in women with SLE and previous adverse obstetric outcomes.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was reported in 18% of live births.
